text:
zoe: Heads-up: customers pushing for per-message routing metadata and strict role semantics. infra wants a lighter path for high-QPS clients. We need a single plan for roadmap planning.

hugo: Proposal: canonical POST /v1/chat with "messages" array (role, content, meta). Also provide an opt-in compact path via header X-Redwood-Mode: compact. No separate compact endpoint to avoid doubling surface.

mica: Agree on canonical messages. Important: document incompatibilities of compact mode up-front: no tool hints, no per-message example flags, structured-output will be degraded.

priya: For rollout: beta behind account feature-flag, soft warn for 72h if clients send multiple system messages, then reject unless using new "system_blocks" array. Must include clear deprecation timeline for raw prompt-only clients.

hugo: Can ops feature-flag per-account and per-region? Dedicated customers may need longer. Also request telemetry hooks: compact -> tool-call success rate, compact -> structured-output fidelity.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: chat_messages_canonical; controls: account-level override, region scheduling.

zoe: Migration helpers: SDKs should include helpers to convert old prompt strings into messages (split examples, inject system). Sample patterns for common languages. Docs must include token-accounting examples comparing compact vs messages with metadata.

mica: Important decision on assistant messages in request: allow only for examples with metadata key "example:true"; otherwise treat as an error to avoid confusion.

priya: Launch must-haves: schema + examples, SDK helpers, docs & cost examples, feature-flag + canary plan, telemetry. Nice-to-have: server-side prompt coercion, x-redwood-compat-warning header, system_blocks. Resource ask: infra ~2 sprints for validator + flagging; SDKs ~1 sprint.

hugo: Ops will draft the deprecation flow: keep legacy prompt endpoint for existing keys for 30 days after beta, email + console notice, then 90 day deprecation window for non-Dedicated accounts.

zoe: I'll own the migration guide + sample repo. mica -> role-rule RFC. hugo -> flag + RFC for compact header semantics. Priya -> schedule product review.

priya: Action items agreed. If no blockers we'll run a 10-customer beta after infra staging for two sprints. :thumbsup:
